vram.label: VRAM Management
vram.help: Controls model VRAM allocation strategy. Default auto-detects the best mode. High VRAM suits large-memory GPUs, while Low VRAM helps on smaller GPUs.

attention.label: Attention Mode
attention.help: PyTorch SDPA is the recommended default and automatically picks an efficient kernel. FlashAttention and SageAttention can be installed in Setup Wizard.

disable_xformers.label: xFormers
disable_xformers.help: With newer PyTorch versions, PyTorch SDPA is usually preferred. Keep xFormers disabled unless you specifically need it.

unet_precision.label: UNet Precision
unet_precision.help: Controls UNet inference precision. FP8 can significantly reduce VRAM usage, while BF16 is recommended on Ampere and newer GPUs.

vae_precision.label: VAE Precision
vae_precision.help: Controls VAE decoding precision. FP32 is the safest, while FP16/BF16 are faster. If you get black images, try switching back to FP32.

text_enc_precision.label: Text Encoder Precision
text_enc_precision.help: Controls text encoder precision. Default is usually fine, while FP8 can save additional VRAM.

fast.label: Experimental Optimization
fast.help: Enables ComfyUI experimental acceleration. It may improve speed, but a small number of workflows could be incompatible.

preview_method.label: Preview Method
preview_method.help: Controls real-time previews during generation. TAESD looks better but is slightly slower; Latent2RGB is faster but blurrier.

cache.label: Cache Strategy
cache.help: Controls node output caching. The LRU Cache Size setting below only takes effect when this is set to LRU. Classic mode is more aggressive and faster, but uses more memory.

cache_lru_size.label: LRU Cache Size
cache_lru_size.help: Sets how many node results can be retained for reuse. Higher values can improve reuse across repeated runs, but consume more memory. Only applies when Cache Strategy is set to LRU.

upcast_attention.label: Attention Upcast
upcast_attention.help: Upcast attention computation to higher precision. Try forcing when output is black/garbled; disabling is for debugging only.

reserve_vram.label: Reserved VRAM (GB)
reserve_vram.help: VRAM reserved for the OS / other software (GB). Helps avoid OOM when running large models on big GPUs alongside a desktop.

vram_headroom.label: Dynamic VRAM Headroom (GB)
vram_headroom.help: Extra VRAM kept free by DynamicVRAM on top of the default. Increase if you keep hitting OOM.

async_offload.label: Async Weight Offload
async_offload.help: Prefetch weights to VRAM asynchronously during sampling to reduce stalls. Enabled by default on Nvidia.

dynamic_vram.label: Dynamic VRAM
dynamic_vram.help: DynamicVRAM schedules model loading by actual VRAM pressure. Disable if you hit repeated unexplained OOM to switch to estimate-based loading.

cuda_device.label: CUDA Devices
cuda_device.help: GPU ids this instance uses (comma-separated, e.g. 0 or 0,1). Other devices become invisible to ComfyUI; leave empty to use all.

fp16_intermediates.label: FP16 Intermediates
fp16_intermediates.help: Experimental: use FP16 for intermediate tensors between nodes. Saves VRAM; some workflows may lose precision.

force_channels_last.label: Channels Last
force_channels_last.help: Force channels-last tensor layout during inference. Faster on some GPUs (e.g. AMD); slower on some workflows.

preview_size.label: Preview Max Size
preview_size.help: Maximum edge size of sampler preview images. Lower reduces preview overhead, higher gives clearer previews.

disable_metadata.label: Output Metadata
disable_metadata.help: Writes generation params (prompt/seed etc.) into output files by default. Disabling keeps files cleaner and slightly smaller but you can no longer trace generation info from the file.

fast_disk.label: Disk-Backed Loading
fast_disk.help: Prefer disk-backed dynamic loading over unpinned RAM, greatly reducing memory usage (especially for large models). Recommended with NVMe.

mmap.label: MMAP File Mapping
mmap.help: Use mmap when loading ckpt/pt files and disable mmap for safetensors, further reducing memory usage.

pinned_memory.label: Pinned Memory
pinned_memory.help: Pinned memory speeds up CPU→GPU transfers but cannot be reclaimed. Disable when system memory is tight.

max_upload_size.label: Upload Limit (MB)
max_upload_size.help: Max upload size on the ComfyUI side (MB). The panel has its own stricter limit; set this higher as a fallback.
